item.title: Optimizing things in the USSR (2016)
item.description:
📝 Because there were too many commodities to track, administrators often limited their analysis to the 10,000 most important commodities in the economy. They can come in different lengths, different shapes, and different compositions. If they did that, it was also necessary to bump up the output targets of commodities that were input into the target commodity.
🔗 Read more: https://chris-said.io/2016/05/11/optimizing-things-in-the-ussr/

item.title: Show HN: Omacosy – Omarchy-style tiling desktop for macOS, no SIP
item.description:
